TitleStatusIntentPeriodDescription
Mental health, drug and alcohol, and hepatitis C care planactiveplan12-Dec 24 - 12-Jun 2520-year-old with newly diagnosed bipolar I disorder (lithium), severe generalised anxiety with agoraphobic avoidance, alcohol and methamphetamine use disorders, and chronic hepatitis C (genotype 3, on treatment). Recent major stressors: parents' separation and the end of a relationship. Plan: mental health treatment plan with the community mental health team (case manager, psychology); lithium levels, renal and thyroid function every 3 months, and lithium safety (no NSAIDs, keep hydrated, report vomiting or diarrhoea). Drug and alcohol service: counselling, consider naltrexone. Complete 12 weeks of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir with weekly dispensing; SVR12 in May 2025; complete hepatitis A and B vaccination. Contraception: implant. Trauma-informed, non-judgemental care; telehealth when she can't come in. She wants to stop drinking and using, and to get back to her art.
